title: Get your first pull request merged into Field Atlas
description:
**[Field Atlas](https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas)** is an offline research app for Android, free and open source (Apache 2.0).

Pick any open issue labelled `reward`, get your pull request merged, and claim this bounty. It is paid on top of the issue's own ATLAS reward. **The first tasks need a phone, not code.**

- **Open tasks:** [issues labelled `reward`](https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Areward)
- **How to contribute and get paid:** [Contributor rewards](https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributor-rewards)

### To claim, all four must hold

1. Your pull request is merged into `main` after this bounty was posted, and it closes an issue labelled `reward`.
2. Your claim image is a screenshot of the merged pull request page, showing your GitHub name.
3. Your claim text has the pull request link.
4. You claim from the same wallet as the `Base address:` line in your pull request.

**The earliest merge that meets all four wins.** Maintainers' own pull requests don't count.

If nothing qualifies by **1 December 2026 (UTC)**, the bounty is cancelled and refunded.

comments.body:
Claimant note for claim 9287, posted from the claiming wallet 0x2481E29895b43e87e547a50fB0BB5aa1E70585EB.

GitHub suspended the swiftbotlab account on 1 Nov at about 21:20 UTC, after this merge. GitHub has not given a reason. That is why the pull request link and the claim image now show 404. The merged work itself is still there, and anyone can check it:

1. Merged commit in main: https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas/commit/fbcde9e

2. The project's reward ledger lists pull request 5, issue 3, swiftbotlab and this wallet as paid: https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas/blob/main/website/rewards.json

3. The ATLAS reward paid to this wallet: https://basescan.org/tx/0xeaed39c79413808d835259cd7901e2602d912e02a6665a0aabcee3e4233cbf4a

4. Issue 3, where the maintainer wrote "assigned to @swiftbotlab, and #5 is going in now": https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas/issues/3

5. Issue 6, which opens "A 12 GB POCO X6 Neo 5G is timed in #3": https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas/issues/6

6. Copy of the merged pull request screenshot: https://apps.swiftbotlab.workers.dev/proof/fieldatlas-pr5-merged.png

Same team, now at github.com/swiftbotlabs.
